persona_and_concept.archetype: Architectural Luxury & Botanical Craft (Swiss editorial meets French-Mexican artisanal perfumery)
persona_and_concept.aesthetic_direction: Light minimalist, high-contrast monochrome backbone with warm bone/limestone canvas and sharp molten bronze-amber accents. No generic AI SaaS gradients. Unconventional asymmetrical layouts, spacious padding, tactile borders, editorial note-pyramids, and distinct dual experience (editorial immersive storefront vs. high-density precision admin command center).

hierarchy_rules.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy_rules.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug

anti_patterns: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk for headings or main labels
DO NOT exceed text-6xl for hero headings; avoid poster-size text jumps
Never center-align long blocks of product descriptions; use crisp left alignment with generous whitespace

color_palette.philosophy: Archetype: Luxury & Organic Tactile. Pure whites (#FFFFFF) and Warm Bone/Linen (#FAF8F5, #F5F2EB) as base, Obsidian Carbon (#121212) for razor-sharp typography and boundaries, with Amber-Ochre (#C58A3E, #9E6B28) as the perfume essence accent.

rules.no_heavy_gradients: No generic 3-stop saturated gradients. Only subtle linear shade from canvas to crisp white or 5% amber glow.
rules.contrast_compliance: Obsidian text on Linen/White yields > 12:1 APCA rating. Amber text must use deep ochre #9E6B28 for small text to pass WCAG AA (4.5:1).
rules.interactive_hover: Hover states must explicitly set text and background color (e.g. hover:bg-stone-900 hover:text-stone-50).

spacing_and_layout_rules.scale_philosophy: Generous luxury spacing (2-3x typical density). Use p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, py-20, py-28 for editorial breathe.
spacing_and_layout_rules.container_padding_rule: Every bordered container MUST have at least p-6 or p-8 internal padding to eliminate text collisions.

header_nav.strategy: Crystal Glass with warm blur: backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/90 border-b border-stone-200/80 sticky top-0 z-50
header_nav.desktop_view: Always display: Logo 'ÉLORIA' in Cormorant Garamond, Category Nav Links (Colección, Familias Olfativas, El Manifiesto, Novedades, Sobre Nosotros), Search trigger, Cart Drawer trigger with count pill, Currency MXN indicator, and Admin/Account link. NEVER hide desktop nav behind a hamburger menu.
header_nav.height: h-20 sm:h-24 px-6 md:px-12 flex items-center justify-between

grid_modes.storefront_catalog: Asymmetrical editorial grid. Base 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8 md:gap-10'. Spotlight first featured bottle with col-span-1 sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2 row-span-2 for visual tension.
grid_modes.product_detail_layout: Split architectural layout: 7-column gallery / hero image on left with zoom and scent aura, 5-column editorial panel on right with notes pyramid (Salida, Corazón, Fondo), real-time stock indicator pill, size selector (50ml, 100ml, Discovery Set 10ml), Add to Cart button, and accordion details.
grid_modes.checkout_stepper: Linear focused breadcrumb stepper (1. Datos Personales -> 2. Método de Envío [Domicilio / Puntos Pick-up] -> 3. Método de Pago [Tarjeta Stripe, Transferencia SPEI, Contra Entrega] -> 4. Confirmación + WhatsApp link). Centered max-w-4xl container with 2-column breakdown (Form on left, Order Summary & Scent Samples on right).
grid_modes.admin_dashboard: High-density Mode B Protocol. Strict grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5. Flat surfaces, 1px tactile borders, no card shadows, instant scanability with metric KPIs (Ventas Totales MXN, Pedidos Pendientes, Valor Promedio, Stock Crítico).

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Gentle, weighted, architectural inertia. Fast enough for rapid shopping, sensory enough for high-end perfumery.
motion_and_interactions.a11y_rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion useReducedMotion() hook.

storefront.tone: Editorial, sensory, immersive luxury fragrance journal
storefront.background: bg-[#FAF8F5] with crisp white card accents
storefront.navigation: Prominent sticky header with brand narrative, olfactory wheel, discovery quiz/filter, cart drawer
storefront.catalog_features: Filter by family (Amaderada, Floral, Cítrica, Oriental, Gourmand, Cuero), intensity filter, stock alert ('Solo 3 disponibles'), quick add-to-cart
storefront.checkout_features: 4 distinct steps, shipping selector (Envío estándar a domicilio, Express CDMX/Guadalajara/Mty, Puntos Pickup en boutiques aliadas Polanco/Roma/San Pedro), payment triggers (Stripe Card, Transferencia SPEI CLABE, Pago contra entrega en efectivo), WhatsApp order confirmation deeplink with prepopulated order summary text

admin.tone: High-density Precision Command Center for Mexican boutique management
admin.background: bg-[#F4F3F0] with stark pure white work surfaces
admin.navigation: Clean persistent dark sidebar (w-64) with ÉLORIA crest, links to Panel Principal, Catálogo de Productos, Categorías / Notas, Inventario & Lotes, Pedidos, Clientes, Métodos de Envío, Puntos Pickup, Configuración General, y Salir
admin.components: Dense metric cards, stock status indicators with low stock alerts, inline edit capabilities, export CSV/Order detail modal, WhatsApp direct contact button for customers

testing_attributes_protocol.requirement: MUST use kebab-case role-based data-testid on every interactive button, input, navigation link, card, cart drawer, checkout step, WhatsApp link, and admin table action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono in public/index.html and tailwind.config.js.
Implement ÉLORIA in pure Mexican Spanish language with MXN currency format (e.g., '$2,450 MXN').
Keep Light Minimalist aesthetic: #FAF8F5 background, crisp white cards, sharp stone-900 border and typography, warm amber accents.

Build the complete e-commerce experience: Catalog with category filters, Search, Product Detail Modal/View with Olfactory Notes pyramid (Salida, Corazón, Fondo), Stock status, Slide-over Cart with instant quantity adjustments.

Multi-step checkout: 1) Datos del Cliente (Nombre, Email, Teléfono, RFC opcional), 2) Envío (Envío a Domicilio con cálculo o Puntos Pick-up en boutiques CDMX/Guadalajara/Monterrey), 3) Método de Pago (Tarjeta con Stripe UI simulado, Transferencia SPEI con CLABE bancaria de Banorte/BBVA, Pago contra entrega en efectivo), 4) Confirmación con folio único y botón directo con deep link 'Enviar pedido a WhatsApp' (https://wa.me/52... con mensaje URL codificado detallando el pedido).

Build protected /admin panel accessible with mock auth or demo bypass: Dashboard with sales analytics chart using Recharts, CRUD management for Products, Categories, Inventory stock alerts, Orders (with status updates: Pendiente, Pagado, En Preparación, Enviado, Entregado), Delivery methods & Pickup points, and Store Settings.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
